files.purpose: The chat conversation's scrolling timeline for one thread: it partitions ThreadRuntime entries into DisplayBlocks (one block per turn), renders them in a windowed LazyVStack inside a ScrollView, and owns all of the scroll-position machinery (follow-the-end pinning, anchor selection, lazy history loading, blank-viewport repair, the AppKit 'nudge' that tells the lazy stack where the viewport is, scroll-freeze for hover/hit-testing during scrolling), plus the running turn's WorkingIndicator card, the block cache, the minimap host and the shared TimelineScrollState / TimelineRevealBox plumbing.

side_effects: Timer-like Tasks: settleWatch polls every 80ms and clears the scroll freeze 0.15s after the last moving frame; phaseWatch polls every 200ms with a 2.0s stall threshold for .interacting, 0.4s otherwise and a 3.0s ceiling; blankWatch sleeps 300ms then bumps checkRequest when showsNothing; armViewportRefresh waits up to 12 x 17ms for a nudge; restoreNudge loops 4 x 17ms then sleeps 17ms; WorkingIndicator ticks .seconds(1) while FrontMonitor.shared.isVisible and the turn is running; the thread-open .task sleeps 250ms before widening the window

feature_notes: Lazy window: first paint shows TimelineWindow.firstPaint = 3 blocks, grows to TimelineWindow.initial = 24 after a 250ms sleep in .task(id: runtime.threadID), then TimelineWindow.page = 24 more blocks per load; loadEarlier sets historyLoadPending and forces anchorsBottomOnGrowth = true so incoming history lands above the viewport without moving the reader

Follow-the-end logic: pinned when distanceFromBottom < 48; anchorsBottomOnGrowth chooses .bottom vs .top for .sizeChanges; a reader move is detected when abs((new.offset - old.offset) - anchorMove) > 1

Scrolling past the end (distanceFromBottom < -1) while at rest and only when contentHeight or containerHeight changed in the same frame snaps to the bottom, deferred through DispatchQueue.main.async with a disablesAnimations transaction

On runtime.isRunning becoming true: a send or a turn for a reader already at the end snaps/animates to the bottom (unanimated when already there, withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.25)) otherwise); an unattended turn (runtime.autoStartedTurnToken differs from seenAutoStartedTurnToken) for a reader who scrolled up does not pull them down

repairLayout escalation for a blank viewport: blankRepairs 0 -> refreshViewport(), 1 -> stackGeneration += 1 plus armViewportRefresh(), 2 -> pin and snap to the bottom plus armViewportRefresh(), 3 and beyond -> give up; any row reporting itself visible cancels the blank watch and resets blankRepairs to 0

refreshViewport 'nudge': beginNudge tries offsets of -1 then +1 points (accepted when abs(target.y - origin.y) > 0.25), restoreNudge puts the clip view back and re-snaps to the bottom if pinned; nudgePhase runs 0 -> 1 (moved) -> 2 (scroll view reported) -> 3 (moving back) -> 0
armViewportRefresh throttling: a burst resets after 2 seconds of quiet and allows at most 8 refreshes per burst
Drift accounting: noteDrift accumulates shrink + drift and fires when it passes jumpTolerance = max(48, viewportHeight / 4); a reader's own scroll resets drift to 0

Scroll freeze: isReaderScrolling turns off hit-testing on the rows via the ScrollFreeze leaf modifier (comment says hover re-hit-testing was about a fifth of the main thread's scroll-time work); it lifts 150ms after the last moving frame, polled every 80ms

Lost scroll phases: a .interacting phase with no reader movement for 2.0s, or a coast with none for 0.4s, or any phase running past 3.0s, is treated as over, reports scrolling false and bumps checkRequest

Minimap jump: jump(to:in:animated:) expands visibleCount to reach a target above the window, sets historyLoadPending, then scrolls to the block id with anchor .top inside withAnimation(.smooth(duration: 0.35)) (or a disablesAnimations transaction when not animated), deferring through DispatchQueue.main.async when the window had to expand
The rail's active tick: resolveActive() takes the middle element of the on-screen run (onScreen[onScreen.count / 2]) and lights the last user block at or above it

Block identity scheme: turn blocks are "turn-<turnID.uuidString>-<first row entry id>", work groups "work-<first entry id>", heads groups "heads-<first entry id>", working "working-<turnID uuidString or empty>", heads-working "hydra-heads-working" or "hydra-heads-working-tail" when trailing

Hydra merge pill: the timeline appends .merging(id:) using runtime.hydraMergeNoteID or the fallback literal "hydra-merging" while runtime.isHydraMerging, and suppresses it once the last entry is a merge outcome; a merge outcome is a user message with isFromHydra true, no hydraHeads, and a first line starting with the literal "Hydra "

Head pills: finished heads are sorted by finishedAt, split at runtime.turnStartedAt into earlier (inserted above the running turn block, only when that turn has no head rows) and later (appended, trailing: isRunning)

Block cache fast path: the cache key is entry ObjectIdentifiers plus turnEnd count, isRunning, hydraMergeID, pills and showReasoning; an append-only key change rebuilds only the last run (buildTail) and keeps earlier blocks, returning nil when a new end marker would fold an already stable turn block; in DEBUG every 20th tail build is compared against a full build and falls back on a mismatch
TimelineBlockCache keeps at most 24 per-thread caches in LRU order
Turn folding: a turn block renders TurnRunningBlock until a TurnSummary exists, then TurnFinishedBlock, both with .transition(.identity) so no fade composites a very tall layer

Transitions: .turn blocks with a summary and work groups of more than softAppearLimit = 8 entries get .identity; everything else gets rowTransition = asymmetric(insertion: SoftAppearModifier(isVisible: false) -> (isVisible: true) animated with .softAppear, removal: .identity)
Reasoning entries never render as rows of their own; they appear only behind the working indicator's chevron, and only when model.settings.showReasoning is on
A work run that has a reply after it starts collapsed (startsCollapsed computed from replyIndices)
Tool entries of kind .agent are pulled out of the work run into a trailing .heads group
Composer growth (scrollState.areaGrowthRequest) only pulls a reader who is pinned or within 48 points of the end, and is skipped while liveResize.isActive
Question badges: when runtime.questions.count drops from non-zero to 0 the timeline arms a viewport refresh; a new question badge pulls any reader to the end regardless of pinning

FrontMonitor.concerns(_:) distinguishes the app becoming active (app-wide, affects every timeline) from a specific window being uncovered, so a popover or tooltip opening over the chat no longer triggers a self-repair
ScrollMetrics reports distanceFromBottom = 0 when contentSize.height + insets <= containerSize.height + 1, and clamps travel to the actual scrollable excess
